root_cause.component: daily request quota (500,000 commands/day) on the fivo-broker instance
root_cause.summary: A steady ~540 commands/min burn took the daily counter from 475,163 at 16:30 to the 500,000 cap by 17:25. Redis then rejected all commands, so the API enqueue raised QueueUnavailable (503) and the worker lost its broker. The source of the high burn is not identified.
